test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shubham said, "I have no brother or sister. This man in the photograph is the husband of my mother's daughter-in-law". Whose photograph is Shubham referring to?
solution:
**Given:**

Shubham has no brother or sister.

The man in the photograph is the husband of Shubham's mother's daughter-in-law.

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83adf6b34f0e218dde4887ea242cc7167544bfc9aae7d856eb6cd0466f75bda0.png] 

**Explanation:**

As Shubham has no brother or sister, He is the only son of his mother.

So, his mother will have only one daughter-in-law.

And, hence, that daughter-in-law's husband will be the son of the mother, that is Shubham.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/040eb6746c42428252c72396d8aa5856a7d5302e4aba002abeeaeaa6914d5dc7.png] 

The man in the photograph is Shubham himself.
